# automox_server_groups (Data Source)

Server groups in the configured organization.

Commonly used to find the default group to parent a new group to, or to look up an existing group's `uuid` for `automox_scheduled_window`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Every server group in the organization.
data "automox_server_groups" "all" {}

# One group by exact name. A name that matches nothing is an error rather than
# an empty list, so a typo fails the plan instead of producing a confusing
# index-out-of-range later.
data "automox_server_groups" "workstations" {
  name = "Corporate Workstations"
}

output "default_group_id" {
  # The default group is identified by being its own parent; the provider
  # derives is_default for you.
  value = one([for g in data.automox_server_groups.all.server_groups : g.id if g.is_default])
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Optional

- `name` (String) Return only the group with this exact name. Omit to return every group.

### Read-Only

- `server_groups` (Attributes List) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--server_groups))

<a id="nestedatt--server_groups"></a>
### Nested Schema for `server_groups`

Read-Only:

- `id` (Number)
- `is_default` (Boolean) True for the organization's default group. Automox marks it by making the group its own parent rather than with a flag, so the provider derives this.
- `name` (String) The default group's name is an empty string; the console displays it as "Default".
- `notes` (String)
- `parent_server_group_id` (Number)
- `policies` (List of Number) IDs of the policies attached to this group.
- `refresh_interval` (Number)
- `server_count` (Number)
- `ui_color` (String)
- `uuid` (String)
